description.zh: 客户端密钥到期时间，Unix时间戳格式，单位为毫秒。可设置的最小有效期为1天，最大有效期为3年。
description.en: The expiration time of the client secret. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds. The minimum validity period that can be set is 1 day, and the maximum validity period is 3 years.

title.zh: 更新一个EIAM应用的客户端密钥有效期
title.en: Update the client secret validity period of an EIAM application

example.unifiedCli: aliyun eiam update-application-client-secret-expiration-time --instance-id idaas_ue2jvisn35ea5lmthk267xxxxx --application-id app_mkv7rgt4d7i4u7zqtzev2mxxxx --secret-id sct_11111 --expiration-time 1735530123762 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun eiam UpdateApplicationClientSecretExpirationTime --region cn-hangzhou --InstanceId idaas_ue2jvisn35ea5lmthk267xxxxx --SecretId sct_11111 --ApplicationId app_mkv7rgt4d7i4u7zqtzev2mxxxx --ExpirationTime 1735530123762
